description: Flat metadata schema for individual calcium imaging records from Drosophila olfactory neuron experiments using two-photon microscopy and odorant stimulation.

record_id.descr: Unique identifier for this metadata record (one row per imaging trial, ROI, or response measurement). Example: 'exp001_trial03_roi12'.

source_file.descr: Name or path of the raw image/data file associated with this record. Example: TIFF, HDF5, NIfTI, or proprietary microscope format.

experiment_date.descr: Date of the imaging experiment in ISO format (YYYY-MM-DD).

experimenter.descr: Name or identifier of the operator or researcher who performed the experiment.

organism.descr: Biological organism studied. Expected value: 'Drosophila melanogaster'.

life_stage.descr: Developmental stage of the fly. Examples: larva, pupa, adult.

sex.descr: Sex of the specimen, if known. Examples: male, female, mixed, unknown.

genotype.descr: Genotype or transgenic line designation of the fly used for imaging.

age_days.descr: Age of the specimen in days at the time of imaging.

preparation_type.descr: Type of preparation used for imaging. Examples: intact fly, dissected brain, ex vivo brain, in vivo.

brain_region.descr: Brain region imaged. Examples: antennal lobe, mushroom body, lateral horn, subesophageal zone.

roi_id.descr: Identifier for the region of interest within the image volume or frame.

roi_definition_method.descr: Method used to define the ROI. Examples: manual, semi-automated, automated, atlas-based.

roi_size_um2.descr: Area of the ROI in square micrometers (µm^2), if applicable for 2D projections.

roi_volume_um3.descr: Volume of the ROI in cubic micrometers (µm^3), if applicable for 3D segmentation.

roi_center_x_um.descr: X-coordinate of the ROI center in micrometers (µm) in the image coordinate system.

roi_center_y_um.descr: Y-coordinate of the ROI center in micrometers (µm) in the image coordinate system.

roi_center_z_um.descr: Z-coordinate of the ROI center in micrometers (µm), if 3D imaging was performed.

roi_annotation_reference.descr: Reference used to annotate the ROI, such as atlas name, anatomical landmark, or segmentation file identifier.

microscope_type.descr: Microscope modality used for imaging. Expected value for this dataset type: two-photon microscope.

microscope_model.descr: Model name or identifier of the microscope.

objective_magnification.descr: Objective magnification used during imaging. Example values: 16, 20, 25, 40, 60.

objective_na.descr: Numerical aperture of the objective lens.

excitation_wavelength_nm.descr: Excitation wavelength used for two-photon imaging, in nanometers (nm).

laser_power_mw.descr: Laser power at the sample or objective, in milliwatts (mW), if measured.

emission_channel.descr: Detection channel or fluorophore emission channel used. Example: green, red, GCaMP, RCaMP.

calcium_indicator.descr: Calcium indicator used to report neuronal activity. Examples: GCaMP6f, GCaMP7s.

image_depth_slices.descr: Number of z-slices acquired in the stack. Use 1 for single-plane imaging.

pixel_size_x_um.descr: Pixel size in the x dimension in micrometers per pixel (µm/px).

pixel_size_y_um.descr: Pixel size in the y dimension in micrometers per pixel (µm/px).

z_step_um.descr: Axial step size between consecutive z-slices in micrometers (µm).

frame_rate_hz.descr: Acquisition frame rate in Hertz (frames per second).

time_per_frame_s.descr: Time per frame in seconds; may be the reciprocal of frame rate if constant.

recording_duration_s.descr: Total duration of the imaging recording in seconds.

stimulus_type.descr: Type of sensory stimulus presented. Expected value: odorant stimulus.

odorant_name.descr: Name of the odorant stimulus used. Example: isoamyl acetate, ethyl acetate, benzaldehyde.

odorant_cas_number.descr: CAS registry number of the odorant, if available.

odorant_concentration.descr: Concentration of the odorant stimulus as a numeric value.

odorant_concentration_units.descr: Units for odorant concentration. Examples: %, v/v, M, mM, µM, ppm.

odorant_delivery_method.descr: Method used to deliver the odorant. Examples: olfactometer, puff, vapor, air dilution system.

odorant_exposure_time_s.descr: Duration of odorant exposure in seconds.

odorant_onset_time_s.descr: Time from recording start to odorant onset in seconds.

odorant_offset_time_s.descr: Time from recording start to odorant offset in seconds.

inter_trial_interval_s.descr: Time between consecutive odor presentations in seconds, if applicable.

stimulus_replicate_number.descr: Replicate number for repeated presentations of the same odorant stimulus.

control_condition.descr: Description of the control condition used for comparison. Examples: blank air, solvent control.

signal_measurement.descr: Type of extracted calcium signal. Examples: fluorescence intensity, deltaF/F, normalized fluorescence, raw intensity.

baseline_window_s.descr: Time window used to compute baseline signal, in seconds, if applicable.

response_window_s.descr: Time window used to compute the response metric, in seconds, if applicable.

response_amplitude.descr: Measured response amplitude for this ROI/trial, in the units of the signal_measurement (often deltaF/F).

response_latency_s.descr: Latency from odor onset to response onset, in seconds.

response_peak_time_s.descr: Time from odor onset to maximum response, in seconds.

snr.descr: Signal-to-noise ratio for the extracted response, if computed.

quality_flag.descr: Quality assessment flag for the record. Expected values could include true/false or categorical codes such as usable, partial, excluded.

motion_correction_applied.descr: Whether motion correction was applied to the imaging data.

background_subtraction_applied.descr: Whether background subtraction was applied during preprocessing.

roi_tracking_method.descr: Method used to track ROIs over time. Examples: fixed ROI, frame-by-frame segmentation, deformable tracking.

anatomical_atlas.descr: Atlas or anatomical reference used for region assignment, if applicable.

comments.descr: Free-text notes relevant to this specific record, such as acquisition issues or unusual stimulus responses.
